_note: Sample data for the demo. Replace with the real facility's information.
name: Demo district hospital

departments.name: Reception and registration
departments.location: Ground floor, at the main entrance
departments.what_happens: Every patient registers here first and gets a patient card. Bring an ID card if you have one.

departments.name: Cashier
departments.what_happens: Pay for the consultation ticket before seeing a doctor. Keep the receipt.

departments.name: Emergency
departments.location: Separate entrance on the left side of the building, open 24 hours
departments.what_happens: For urgent cases. Patients are seen in order of urgency, not arrival.

departments.name: General consultation
departments.what_happens: Wait on the benches until your number is called. A nurse takes your temperature and blood pressure first.

departments.name: Maternity
departments.location: Building B, behind the main building
departments.what_happens: Pregnancy follow-up and deliveries. Bring your pregnancy booklet.

departments.name: Pediatrics
departments.what_happens: Consultations for children under 15. A parent must come with the child.

departments.name: Laboratory
departments.what_happens: Bring the doctor's request form and the payment receipt. Some tests need you to come without eating.

departments.name: Pharmacy
departments.location: Ground floor, next to the exit
departments.what_happens: Bring the prescription written by the doctor.

urgent_signs: a pregnant woman with bleeding or strong pain
a child who cannot drink or is very weak
